label: <DEL> or original-phase 3 input, in sequences starting with 1/m/0/n
explanation: Fires almost only at the delimiter step (48% of mass, but only 6% of delimiter steps fire) and on original-phase input 3 (31% of mass, 15% of those steps fire). Weaker firing on original-phase q/v/g/l. Rarely fires in the copy phase (5% of mass) and never at t=0. Firing depends on sequence context: rate is much higher when the first token is 1 (6.3x), m, 0 or n, when earlier inputs include 1/m, when there are more digits, and for longer sequences (L=9, late positions). The union of delimiter and original 3 covers 79% of mass but has 7% precision. Adding the first-token condition gives F1 0.33 on dev. The context dependence looks distributed, and no simple predicate gets precision high.
